title: Signer weights above 32,767 wrap when stored as signer_weight_old / signer_weight_new (int16)
severity_basis: EffectsProcessor.parseSigners converts signer weights to int16 with no range check before they are stored in state_changes.signer_weight_old / signer_weight_new (SMALLINT). A signer weight is a uint32 in XDR and stellar-core refuses a weight above 255 only from protocol 10 on, so only a signer added before protocol 10 with a weight above 32,767 is affected: its row is written with a wrapped weight (40,000 becomes -25,536). No halt; whether such a signer is still present on mainnet was not checked.
caps_note: No CAP applies: signer weights (Signer, SetOptions) are classic ledger fields that predate CAPs.

entries.expected: the stored signer weight equals the signer's weight on the ledger, or an out-of-range weight is rejected
entries.observed: No corpus entry demonstrates it. XDR402 at internal/indexer/processors/effects.go:598 (EffectsProcessor.parseSigners): int16(oldVal) narrows the int32 from AccountEntry.SignerSummary() with no range check, and the result is stored as signer_weight_old (make lint-wallet-backend).

evidence.pre_fix: make lint-wallet-backend (xdrlint with the shipped wallet-backend profile at the pinned commit 3e22515a): XDR402 at internal/indexer/processors/effects.go:598, suppressed with this record as its finding. The same function converts the new weight the same way (line 572, from the effect details).
evidence.expected_basis: A signer weight is a uint32 in the XDR definitions (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-xdr/blob/v30.0/Stellar-ledger-entries.x); stellar-core's SetOptionsOpFrame refuses a weight above 255 (SET_OPTIONS_BAD_SIGNER) only from protocol 10 on, and the upgrade did not rewrite older signers, so a stored weight above 32,767 is a value the ledger can hold.

reproduction.method: The linter row fired again at 3e22515a in make lint-wallet-backend; the wrap itself was confirmed by reading the source, not by ingesting a ledger with such a signer (the issue says so).

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-18 as https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/825; this record restates the public issue.
